items.prompt: What does the writer suggest about the excavation of the Collegium Augustalium?

options.text: Digging there began only after the glassy material was noticed
More than one body was recovered from the building
The building had probably been in use as a private home
The remains found there were excavated fairly recently

items.evidence: Among the victims uncovered during excavations of the Collegium Augustalium, a public building in the town centre, was a young man of around 20 years old, found lying face down on a wooden bed where he had apparently been sleeping when the flows arrived.

distractor_analysis.A: Ters sira -- B/2 kalintilarin arkeologlarca 1960'lardan beri bilindigini, camsi maddenin ise cok daha sonraki bir incelemede fark edildigini soyluyor; secenek iki olayin sirasini tersine ceviriyor.
distractor_analysis.C: Yer degistirme -- Collegium Augustalium B/1'de kent merkezinde bir KAMU binasi olarak tanitiliyor; ozel konut oldugu hicbir yerde soylenmiyor.
distractor_analysis.D: Kapsam kaydirma -- yakin tarihli olan sey kazi degil inceleme; kalintilar B/2'ye gore altmis yildir biliniyor.

items.explanation: Paragraph B introduces the young man as one 'among the victims uncovered during excavations' of the Collegium Augustalium, which implies that other bodies were found there as well.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Why does the writer mention timber roof beams, food and fabric?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: These flows swept through the streets and buildings so quickly that many residents were killed almost instantly, and over the following days the town was sealed beneath roughly 20 metres of volcanic deposits, a burial so complete that timber roof beams, food, and even fabric survived for centuries in a way rarely seen at other Roman sites.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Sorunun ekseni arkeoloji genel bilgisi: Herculaneum'un organik malzemeyi -- ahsap, yiyecek, kumas -- olaganustu iyi korumasiyla taninmasi yaygin bir bilgi. Sayilan nesnelerin neden anildigi bu bilgiyle dogrudan biliniyor; secenek dengelemesi bunu kapatmaz.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Yuva bosaltilip ayni pasajdan yeni bir soruyla dolduruldu. Eski soru A/3'e dayaniyordu: ahsap kirislerin, yiyecegin ve kumasin neden anildigi. Herculaneum'un organik malzemeyi olaganustu iyi korumasi arkeolojinin en cok anlatilan olgularindan biri oldugu icin 'kirilgan seyler alisilmadik bicimde dayandi' cevabi pasajsiz da cikiyordu. Yeni soru A paragrafina hic degmiyor: kanit B/1'e tasindi ve cevap tek bir sozcugun tasidigi cikarima baglandi ('Among the victims uncovered' -> binada baska kurbanlar da vardi). Bu, vaka hakkinda okunmus her seyin disinda kalan bir metin ayrintisi; en cok anlatilan ayrintilar (yatak, uyku, yas) bilerek soru ekseni yapilmadi. Uc celdirici de metnin verdigi sirayi ya da tanimi tersine ceviriyor. Kip dengesi icin iki celdirici olculu yazildi ('probably', 'fairly recently').

items.prompt: What was the team's purpose-built image-processing method used for?

options.text: Working out which elements the glassy material contained
Checking that the sheaths still had all their layers
Picking out real nerve tissue among the glass around it
Matching the proteins found against brain reference databases

items.evidence: A custom image-processing method, developed to detect the repeating pattern typical of myelin, the fatty sheath that wraps around nerve fibres, helped distinguish genuine neural structures from random glassy debris.

distractor_analysis.A: Yer degistirme -- kimyasal bilesimi olcen is, ayni paragrafta sayilan enerji dagilimli X isini yontemine ait (D/2); goruntu isleme rutininin islevi bu degil.
distractor_analysis.B: Kapsam kaydirma -- kiliflarin cok katmanli yapisini korudugu E/2'de bir olcum sonucu olarak veriliyor; yontem katmanlarin eksiksizligini dogrulamak icin degil, miyeline ozgu tekrarlayan deseni yakalamak icin gelistirildi.
distractor_analysis.D: Yer degistirme -- proteinlerin referans veri tabanlariyla karsilastirilmasi D/4'te ayri ve son basamak olarak sayiliyor; goruntu isleme rutini protein degil desen ariyor.

items.explanation: Paragraph D says the custom image-processing method, developed to detect the repeating pattern typical of myelin, helped distinguish genuine neural structures from random glassy debris.
items.flag_reason: Cevap C, ozel goruntu isleme yonteminin islevini dogrudan veriyor: miyelinin tekrarlayan desenini yakalayarak gercek sinir yapilarini rastgele camsi kalintidan ayirmak; A kimyasal bilesim olcumunu, B katman butunlugunu dogrulamayi, D ornek sayisini iddia ediyor, ucu de metnin verdigi islevle celisir.

revision.onceki_prompt: What did the team's purpose-built image-processing method make possible?

onceki_secenekler.B: Confirming every sheath layer had survived
onceki_secenekler.C: Telling real nerve structures from stray fragments
onceki_secenekler.D: Examining a much larger set of samples

revision.ne_degisti: Eski D ('cok daha buyuk bir ornek kumesi') uydurmaydi ve buluntunun tek bir bireye ait olmasiyla acikca celisiyordu; B ise dogrulanamayan bir mutlaklik ('her katman') tasiyordu. Dort secenek de artik D ve E paragraflarinda gercekten anlatilan islerden biri (X isini olcumu, katmanli yapinin olculmesi, desen ayikliyici rutin, veri tabani karsilastirmasi); hangi isin hangi yontemin oldugunu bilmek icin paragrafi okumak gerekiyor. Dogru secenek kanit cumlesinin sozcuklerinden de uzaklastirildi.

items.prompt: Which TWO findings about the structures inside the tissue does the writer report?

options.text: Individual cell bodies were all much the same width
Cell bodies ranged from under 3 to over 14 micrometres across
The axons were probably wider than those of a living brain
The sheaths had lost the layered form they once had
Axons from the spinal cord were usually thicker than those in the brain
The sheaths kept exactly the repeating pattern of ordinary nerve tissue
The measurements were probably only approximate

items.evidence: Individual cell bodies ranged from 2.7 to 14.2 micrometres across, and the myelin sheaths retained their characteristic multilayered structure, complete with the regular repeating pattern seen under a microscope in ordinary, unfossilised nervous tissue.

distractor_analysis.A: Kapsam kaydirma -- E/3 hucre govdelerini 2,7 ile 14,2 mikrometre arasinda veriyor; bes kattan fazla fark eden bir araligi 'hemen hemen ayni' diye ozetlemek olcuyu siliyor.
distractor_analysis.C: Yer degistirme -- E/2 camlasmis dokudaki aksonlarin ortalama 717,7 nanometre oldugunu ve bunun canli beyindeki ak madde araligina YAKIN dustugunu soyluyor; daha genis olduklari soylenmiyor.
distractor_analysis.D: Ters yon -- ayni cumle miyelin kiliflarinin cok katmanli yapiyi KORUDUGUNU soyluyor.
distractor_analysis.E: Sayi kaydirma -- omurilikten gelen aksonlar yaklasik 672, beyindekiler 717,7 nanometre; siralama secenektekinin tersi.
distractor_analysis.G: Ters yon -- E/1 yapisal olcumlerin 'remarkably precise' (dikkate deger olcude kesin) oldugunu soyluyor.

items.explanation: Paragraph E reports that individual cell bodies ranged from 2.7 to 14.2 micrometres across, and that the myelin sheaths kept the regular repeating pattern seen in ordinary, unfossilised nervous tissue.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Which TWO points does the writer make about the material's chemistry?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The team detected seven distinct proteins known to be expressed specifically in brain tissue, including one involved in stabilising the internal skeleton of nerve cells and another essential for communication between neurons. By atomic composition the vitrified material was dominated by carbon and oxygen, the two elements that make up the bulk of organic tissue, at roughly 65 and 31 per cent respectively.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Sorunun ekseni temel kimya/biyoloji bilgisi: organik dokunun buyuk kismini karbon ve oksijenin olusturmasi (B) ve beyin dokusunda noronlar arasi iletisimle ilgili bir proteinin bulunmasi (F) beklenen bulgular. Iki dogru secenek de pasaji degil alan bilgisini siniyor.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Yuva bosaltilip ayni pasajdan yeni bir soruyla dolduruldu. Eski soru F/2 ve G/1'e dayaniyordu: karbon-oksijen agirligi ve noronlar arasi iletisim proteini. Organik dokunun karbon temelli olmasi da beyin dokusunda sinyal proteini bulunmasi da beklenen bulgular oldugu icin B+F ikilisi pasajsiz seciliyordu. Yeni soru F ve G paragraflarina hic degmiyor: kanit E/3'e, olculen buyukluklere tasindi. Hucre govdesi araliginin genis mi dar mi oldugu ve kiliflarin desenini koruyup korumadigi ancak olcum sonucundan bilinir; celdiriciler de ayni paragrafin gercek sayilarini ters cevirerek kuruldu (omurilik/beyin siralamasi, akson genisligi, olcum kesinligi), yani alan bilgisi hicbir secenegi elemiyor. Konumsal duzen icin harf cifti B+F secildi; C+F ikilisi bu calistirmada hicbir yuvada kullanilmadi.
